metadata.name: ipow_vault
metadata.description: The iPoW protocol's vault on Solana: vETH, the receipt for ETH locked on Ethereum. Spec: docs/design/ipow-protocol.md, section 11.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The program's upgrade authority.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: handler against the upgradeable loader's layout.

accounts.name: claim
docs: checked and created only if it opens.

accounts.name: buffer
docs: The transaction and batch, when uploaded to a buffer of the submitter.

types.name: Btc
docs: A Bitcoin transaction in a block below a real block (D108).

fields.name: real
docs: A block already recorded as real, with `block` below it.

types.name: Buffer
docs: A message's Bitcoin transaction and batch, uploaded in pieces when they do
not fit in one Solana transaction with its proof.

types.name: Chain
docs: An operator's pair chain (D106) and what it keeps in the vault.

fields.name: peer_operator
docs: The same operator on Ethereum.

fields.name: slashed
docs: A false record was proven here: the bond is gone (D109).

fields.name: refused
docs: A claim of the chain was refused here: no other claim acts (D111).

fields.name: bond
docs: vETH held for the chain, in gwei (D110).

fields.name: stated
docs: The part of the bond its BOND record stated for Solana.

fields.name: deposits
docs: Lamports for the flat deposits of its claims.

fields.name: peer_bond
docs: The ETH bond on Ethereum, counted once its BOND claim is official.

fields.name: open_value
docs: The value of its open claims here, in gwei.

types.name: Claim
docs: The acting records of one message (D111).

fields.name: payout
docs: Set when decided: what each deposit of the winning side collects.

fields.name: records
docs: The LOCK records it carries, one after the other.

types.name: Config
docs: The vault's one settings record. Its address is the key the vault
registered with the protocol, the authority of vETH, and the holder of
deposits and lamport credits.

fields.name: ethereum_vault
docs: The vault on Ethereum, as a registration names it (D106).

fields.name: deposit
docs: V1: the flat deposit to object or answer, and the operator's deposit
for a claim, in lamports.

fields.name: min_certifying_escrow
docs: D118: the least escrow of a job whose proof block counts as real, in
lamports.

types.name: Credit
docs: Lamports and vETH an address can withdraw.

fields.name: payer
docs: Who paid the fees and receives them back (D62, D65).

fields.name: commitment_fee
docs: The fee at the price of the moment, and what was sent above the fees

fields.name: claim_kind
docs: 0 for a settlement, otherwise the kind of claim, counted from 1.

fields.name: tip
docs: The block on top of the proof that was shown with it.

fields.name: deepest
docs: The oldest block of the operator's branch asked for and shown (D81).

fields.name: parents_shown
docs: How many parents were shown; the next question is this + 1 (D91).

fields.name: attester
docs: D42: who locked x in the operator's place, if anyone.

fields.name: open_challenges
docs: How many challenges of the job are open.

types.name: LockMark
docs: What became of a lock on Ethereum here: its receipt issued, or given up
by its recipient. It exists once either happened, so each happens once.

types.name: Protocol
docs: The single record of the protocol. It holds no key: nothing can change
after deployment (D59).

types.name: Real
docs: A block known to be on real Bitcoin (D108).

types.name: Request
docs: A burn of vETH for ETH on Ethereum (section 11.5).

fields.name: amount
docs: In gwei.

types.name: Stake
docs: The deposits one address put down on each side of one claim.
